title: 第19章 吞海剑第20章 完美筑基
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
又过了好一阵，已经快中午了，依然不见秦风的身影。
台下的众人纷纷议论，楼海浪道：“不会不敢来了吧？”
于川道：“我看有可能，是看陈玉龙师兄厉害，就当缩头乌龟了吧。”
柳梦瑶气愤道：“你才缩头乌龟，我二师兄答应了就一定会来的。”
台上的穆无双心中嘀咕，难道是因为自己逼他答应比斗，生气了？
如果不愿意，可以不答应啊，这样放鸽子多丢人。
搞得她现在脸上有点挂不住。
楼万里问道：“师妹，秦峰人呢？”
穆无双不耐烦道：“我哪知道，再等等吧！”
时间已经快到中午，甚至有些不耐烦的弟子都已经离开了。
有一眼尖的弟子道：“你们看，秦峰师兄来了！”
只见秦峰腰里别着一把破剑，晃晃悠悠的往这边走。
昨天因为在四师伯那里弄了两瓶梨花醉，他一高兴喝断片儿了，把比赛这事忘了。
直到他发现宗门各处都没什么人，才想起来比赛的事。
看到秦峰过来，柳梦瑶瞬间化成小迷妹喊道：“二师兄加油！”
这一幕让无数男弟子羡慕的要死，柳梦瑶虽然显现出病态，却丝毫掩盖不住她的美貌与气质。
这种病态美更激起了无数男人的保护欲，无数人追求柳梦瑶都被拒绝了。
没想到她居然对这个又懒又贪酒的师兄情有独钟，难道这就是近水楼台？
秦峰向众人摆了摆手道：“不好意思啊，让各位久等了。”
这比斗台足有一人多高。

他手扶边缘，准备来一个漂亮的纵跃跳到台上。
哪知手一滑直接摔到台下，惊起了一阵烟尘。
在场所有人顿时石化，随即就是一阵哄堂大笑。
穆无双捂住额头，骂道：“靠，你个炼气期，走台阶不好吗！”
她都没脸见人了。
其他长老也都笑了起来。
秦峰从地上爬了起来，郁闷道：“这酒劲有点大，看来下次得少喝点了。”
最后他只能从台阶走到了比斗台之上，陈玉龙看到一身酒气的秦峰，一脸嫌弃。
陈玉龙傲然道：“我有点后悔挑战你了，因为你根本不配成为我的对手。”
他并没有拔剑的意思，而是对秦峰道：“你出手吧，我不用武器！”
秦峰看了看武道台边上的一名青年道：“可以开始了吗？”
此人正是宗门大师兄宁飞，林青河有意让他锻炼锻炼，所以让他充当这次的裁判。
宁飞叮嘱道：“同门切磋，不得害人性命，不得废人修为，现在，比斗正式开始！”
他刚说完，只见秦峰一剑劈出‘吞海’，这是诛天剑诀第二剑，他已练到化境。
只见整个武道台仿佛涌起了千丈海浪，汹涌澎湃，仿佛要吞没一切。
陈玉龙瞳孔微缩，他没想到秦峰居然发出这么恐怖的一击，他有点后悔之前轻敌了。
立刻抽出背后的大剑抵挡，此刻也顾不上之前承诺的不用剑了。
他就仿佛海浪中的一叶小舟。
瞬间被拍的倒飞出去，将武道台周围的防护阵都撞出一个窟窿，远远的摔在了台下昏死过去。
content_en:
After a while, it was almost noon, and Qin Feng was still nowhere to be seen.
Everyone in the audience was talking about it, and Lou Hailang said: "You don't dare to come, do you?"
Yu Chuan said: "I think it's possible that because Senior Brother Chen Yulong is so good, he just shrinks his head."
Liu Mengyao said angrily: "You are just shy. My second senior brother will definitely come if he promised."
Mu Wushuang on the stage muttered to himself, was he angry because he forced him to agree to the competition?
If you don't want to, you don't have to agree. It would be embarrassing to let go.
It made her look a little embarrassed now.
Lou Wanli asked: "Junior sister, where is Qin Feng?"
Mu Wushuang said impatiently: "I don't know, just wait!"
It was almost noon, and even some impatient disciples had already left.
A disciple with sharp eyes said: "Look, Senior Brother Qin Feng is here!"
I saw Qin Feng walking towards this side with a broken sword in his waist.
Yesterday, because he got two bottles of pear blossom wine from his fourth uncle, he drank them all when he was happy and forgot about the competition.
It wasn't until he found that there was no one anywhere in the sect that he thought about the competition.
Seeing Qin Feng coming, Liu Mengyao instantly turned into a little girl and shouted: "Second senior brother, come on!"
This scene made countless male disciples extremely envious. Although Liu Mengyao appeared to be sick, her beauty and temperament could not be concealed at all.
This kind of morbid beauty aroused the protective desire of countless men, and countless people pursued Liu Mengyao but were rejected.
Unexpectedly, she had a soft spot for this lazy and alcoholic senior brother. Could it be that this was a close friend?
Qin Feng waved his hands to everyone and said, "I'm sorry to keep you waiting for so long."
This is more than one person taller than the fighting platform.
He held his hand on the edge, preparing to jump onto the stage with a beautiful leap.
Unexpectedly, his hand slipped and he fell directly to the stage, causing a burst of smoke and dust.
Everyone present was immediately petrified, followed by a burst of laughter.
Mu Wushuang covered his forehead and cursed: "Damn, you are in the Qi refining stage, why don't you walk up the stairs?"
She was too embarrassed to see anyone.
The other elders also laughed.
Qin Feng got up from the ground and said depressedly: "This wine is a bit strong. It seems that I will have to drink less next time."
In the end, he could only walk up the steps to the competition platform. Chen Yulong looked disgusted when he saw Qin Feng smelling of alcohol.
Chen Yulong said proudly: "I kind of regret challenging you, because you are not worthy of being my opponent at all."
He didn't mean to draw his sword, but said to Qin Feng: "You take action, I don't use weapons!"
Qin Feng looked at a young man next to the martial arts platform and said, "Can we start?"
This person was none other than Ning Fei, the eldest brother of the sect. Lin Qinghe wanted to train him, so he asked him to be the referee this time.
Ning Fei warned: "When competing with fellow disciples, you must not harm others' lives or ruin their cultivation. Now, the competition officially begins!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he saw Qin Feng strike out with his sword, "Swallowing the Sea". This was the second sword of the Heaven-Slaying Sword Technique, and he had already practiced it to the transformation state.
I saw that the entire martial arts platform seemed to be filled with thousands of feet of waves, surging and surging, as if it was going to swallow everything.
Chen Yulong's pupils shrank slightly. He didn't expect Qin Feng to deliver such a terrifying blow. He regretted for underestimating the enemy before.
He immediately drew out the big sword from his back to resist. At this moment, he didn't care about not using the sword as he had promised before.
He is like a small boat in the waves.
He was instantly shot and flew backwards, knocking a hole in the protective formation around the martial arts stage, and fell far away from the stage and passed out.
